en:
...Tsumugi just asked me if I can perform
a "rocket punch."

Why does everyone automatically assume
that robots have a rocket punch function!?
I don't have a violent function like that!

I have lots of functions! Useful functions!
I'll show them to you!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time watching Keebo
show off his functions...

<CLT=cltMIND>The functions seemed a bit...unnecessary,
but I kept quiet.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
